subject: The Thinker
hook: THE THINKER IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK
angle: The iconic statue known as 'The Thinker' was originally named 'The Poet' and was modeled after a muscular French prizefighter from the red-light district.
angle_support: The Thinker was initially named The Poet (French: Le Poète)
The model for this sculpture, as for other works by Rodin, was the muscular French prizefighter and wrestler Jean Baud, who mostly appeared in the red-light district.
title: The Secret Identity of The Thinker
description: Discover the surprising truth behind Rodin's masterpiece. The famous statue was modeled after a real prizefighter from Paris's red-light district.
narration: THE THINKER IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK You picture a deep, scholarly philosopher frozen in silent contemplation. It was actually named The Poet, and its true origins are far more gritty than you might imagine. The figure was modeled after Jean Baud, a muscular French prizefighter and wrestler. He spent his days working in Paris's rough red-light district. Foundry workers later renamed the sculpture after they noticed a passing resemblance to Michelangelo's work. The icon of intellect began as a brawling fighter from Paris.
